text: You see a technician. He is working diligently for the Unity and the Master.
source_text: You see a technician. He is working diligently for the Unity and the Master.

text: We do the work of the Master.
source_text: We do the work of the Master.

text: We do the work of the Master, and we cannot be interrupted!
source_text: We do the work of the Master, and we cannot be interrupted!

text: Master! An intruder!
source_text: Master! An intruder!

text: You see Viscious, a super mutant leader. He looks mean.
source_text: You see Viscious, a super mutant leader. He looks mean.

text: You see a mean-looking super mutant.
source_text: You see a mean-looking super mutant.

text: The will of the Master prevails. What news do you have for me?
source_text: The will of the Master prevails. What news do you have for me?

text: Hng!
source_text: Hng!

text: Uh, the war goes well.
source_text: Uh, the war goes well.

text: I have a message for the Master from his Lieutenant. I must see the Master now.
source_text:
I have a message for the Master from his Lieutenant. I must see the
 Master now.

text: The only news that I have is that you're about to become fertilizer.
source_text: The only news that I have is that you're about to become fertilizer.

text: An intruder!
source_text: An intruder!

text: Your manner betrays you, intruder. I will end the threat here.
source_text: Your manner betrays you, intruder. I will end the threat here.

text: You cannot be serious. In fact, you must be lying.
source_text: You cannot be serious. In fact, you must be lying.

text: Uh, yeah, so what?
source_text: Uh, yeah, so what?

text: I'm not. The Lieutenant could not trust this message to the usual method. I have to see the Master right now! There is no time to waste!
source_text:
I'm not. The Lieutenant could not trust this message to the usual
 method. I have to see the Master right now! There is no time to waste!

text: Then use the door, and beware the Corridor. I assume that you have your protection in place?
source_text:
Then use the door, and beware the Corridor. I assume that you have
 your protection in place?

text: Of course. Thank you. Unity prevails.
source_text: Of course. Thank you. Unity prevails.

text: No, not really. Should I?
source_text: No, not really. Should I?

text: Of course! You cannot hope to pass the Corridor without it. What did you do with your nullifier!
source_text:
Of course! You cannot hope to pass the Corridor without it. What did
 you do with your nullifier!

text: I left it in my other robes.
source_text: I left it in my other robes.

text: The Lieutenant did not have time to give me one.
source_text: The Lieutenant did not have time to give me one.

text: Ah, humor, I like that. [pauses] I do not have one, obviously. You need to go get one from the braindrains on the second level. Unity prevails.
source_text:
Ah, humor, I like that. [pauses] I do not have one, obviously. You

text: Then he was a fool, or you are not who you seem to be. What is it?
source_text: Then he was a fool, or you are not who you seem to be. What is it?

text: Obviously, he is a fool.
source_text: Obviously, he is a fool.

text: The second part.
source_text: The second part.

text: Move alone and continue your mission. I haven't the time for you.
source_text: Move alone and continue your mission. I haven't the time for you.

text: There is a small pile of cigarette butts in the corner of the room.
